title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 081
review_goal: Differentiate rss, sandglass, and save variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square tile holding one lower dot with two broadcast arcs rising inside the frame
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the RSS mark contained inside a rounded square badge or app style tile.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the loose RSS signal when the dot and arcs should appear without any outer frame.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot encloses the RSS signal inside a rounded square instead of leaving the arcs free in open space.

items.depicts_observation: One lower dot with two broadcast arcs floating freely without any outer square frame
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a bare RSS signal with no container around the dot and arcs.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the RSS tile when the same signal should sit inside a rounded square badge.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the surrounding tile and leaves only the dot with the two expanding arcs.

items.depicts_observation: Angular hourglass with flat top and bottom caps and two straight triangular chambers touching at the waist
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a geometric hourglass with crisp flat ends and a narrow center pinch.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the softer hourglass variant when the sides should bow outward in a more rounded shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reads as a sharper hourglass built from straighter triangular chambers rather than curved sides.

items.depicts_observation: Hourglass with rounded outer sides that curve inward toward a pinched middle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an hourglass silhouette with softer bowed sides instead of a rigid angular frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straighter hourglass when the chambers should look more triangular with flatter end caps.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot smooths the hourglass into curved sides instead of the harder angular silhouette in the first variant.

items.depicts_observation: Document page with one folded corner and a large check mark centered inside the page
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants save to feel like a confirmed document or completed file action.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the floppy disk variant when the save concept should reference storage media instead of a checked page.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a paper page with a check mark rather than a floppy disk body.
